legend: Bakry faced a problem, but since he's lazy to solve it, he asks for your help.

You are given a tree of n$$$n$$$ nodes, the i$$$i$$$-th node has value ai$$$a_i$$$ assigned to it for each i$$$i$$$ from 1$$$1$$$ to n$$$n$$$. As a reminder, a tree on n$$$n$$$ nodes is a connected graph with n−1$$$n-1$$$ edges.
You want to delete at least 1$$$1$$$, but at most k−1$$$k-1$$$ edges from the tree, so that the following condition would hold:
For every connected component calculate the bitwise XOR of the values of the nodes in it. Then, these values have to be the same for all connected components.
Is it possible to achieve this condition?
input: Each test contains multiple test cases. The first line contains the number of test cases t$$$t$$$ (1≤t≤5⋅104)$$$(1 \leq t \leq 5 \cdot 10^4)$$$. Description of the test cases follows.
The first line of each test case contains two integers n$$$n$$$ and k$$$k$$$ (2≤k≤n≤105)$$$(2 \leq k \leq n \leq 10^5)$$$.
The second line of each test case contains n$$$n$$$ integers a1,a2,...,an$$$a_1, a_2, ..., a_n$$$ (1≤ai≤109)$$$(1 \leq a_i \leq 10^9)$$$.

The i$$$i$$$-th of the next n−1$$$n-1$$$ lines contains two integers ui$$$u_i$$$ and vi$$$v_i$$$ (1≤ui,vi≤n$$$1 \leq u_i, v_i \leq n$$$, ui≠vi$$$u_i\neq v_i$$$), which means that there's an edge between nodes ui$$$u_i$$$ and vi$$$v_i$$$.
It is guaranteed that the given graph is a tree.
It is guaranteed that the sum of n$$$n$$$ over all test cases doesn't exceed 2⋅105$$$2 \cdot 10^5$$$.
output: For each test case, you should output a single string. If you can delete the edges according to the conditions written above, output "YES" (without quotes). Otherwise, output "NO" (without quotes).
You can print each letter of "YES" and "NO" in any case (upper or lower).
note: It can be shown that the objection is not achievable for first, third, and fifth test cases.

In the second test case, you can just remove all the edges. There will be 5$$$5$$$ connected components, each containing only one node with value 3$$$3$$$, so the bitwise XORs will be 3$$$3$$$ for all of them.
In the fourth test case, this is the tree: ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/deeb14a3ca4684db806685d5cfe4fd47751127e4.png).
The bitwise XOR of the first component will be, a1⊕a2⊕a3⊕a4=1⊕6⊕4⊕1=2$$$a_1 \oplus a_2 \oplus a_3 \oplus a_4 = 1 \oplus 6 \oplus 4 \oplus 1 = 2$$$ (where ⊕$$$\oplus$$$ denotes the bitwise XOR).
The bitwise XOR of the second component will be, a5=2$$$a_5 = 2$$$.

legend.ai: Bakry 遇到了一个问题，但他懒得解决，于是向你求助。
给定一棵包含 n$$$n$$$ 个节点的树，对于每个 i$$$i$$$(从 1$$$1$$$ 到 n$$$n$$$)，第 i$$$i$$$ 个节点被赋予值 ai$$$a_i$$$。提醒一下，包含 n$$$n$$$ 个节点的树是一个有 n−1$$$n-1$$$ 条边的连通图。
你需要从这棵树中删除至少 1$$$1$$$ 条、但至多 k−1$$$k-1$$$ 条边，使得满足以下条件：
对于每个连通分量，计算其中所有节点的值的按位异或。然后，所有连通分量的这些值必须相同。
是否可能达到这一条件？

input.ai: 每组测试包含多个测试用例。第一行包含测试用例的数量 t$$$t$$$ (1≤t≤5⋅104)$$$(1 \leq t \leq 5 \cdot 10^4)$$$。下面给出各测试用例的描述。
每个测试用例的第一行包含两个整数 n$$$n$$$ 和 k$$$k$$$ (2≤k≤n≤105)$$$(2 \leq k \leq n \leq 10^5)$$$。
接下来的 n−1$$$n-1$$$ 行中的第 i$$$i$$$ 行包含两个整数 ui$$$u_i$$$ 和 vi$$$v_i$$$ (1≤ui,vi≤n$$$1 \leq u_i, v_i \leq n$$$, ui≠vi$$$u_i\neq v_i$$$)，表示节点 ui$$$u_i$$$ 和 vi$$$v_i$$$ 之间存在一条边。
保证给出的图是一棵树。
保证所有测试用例中 n$$$n$$$ 的总和不超过 2⋅105$$$2 \cdot 10^5$$$。

output.ai: 对于每个测试用例，你需要输出一个字符串。如果可以按照上述条件删除边，则输出 "YES"（不含引号）；否则，输出 "NO"（不含引号）。
你可以以任意大小写形式输出 "YES" 和 "NO" 中的每个字母。

note.ai: 可以证明，在第 1、3、5 个测试用例中无法满足该要求。
在第二个测试用例中，你可以直接删除所有边。这样会有 5$$$5$$$ 个连通分量，每个分量只包含一个值为 3$$$3$$$ 的节点，因此它们的按位异或结果均为 3$$$3$$$。
在第四个测试用例中，树如下：![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/deeb14a3ca4684db806685d5cfe4fd47751127e4.png)。
第一个连通分量的按位异或结果为 a1⊕a2⊕a3⊕a4=1⊕6⊕4⊕1=2$$$a_1 \oplus a_2 \oplus a_3 \oplus a_4 = 1 \oplus 6 \oplus 4 \oplus 1 = 2$$$(其中 ⊕$$$\oplus$$$ 表示按位异或)。
第二个连通分量的按位异或结果为 a5=2$$$a_5 = 2$$$。
